shape_description: Single open curl, curved top stroke sweeping down into a bottom hook curling up-right; s and u near-identical; chose s for rounder top
Short 4-like head over heavy descending stem, horizontal crossbar low on the stem; crossbar position matches E-a
Long horizontal crossbar through middle, lower-left loop, diagonal body; matches E-r looped crossed form
4-like head over stem with long thin crossbar through lower stem extending far left; stem matches E-a
y/4-like head, stem crossed by a bar in the lower half, slightly curved top; same as E-a
Small 4-like head over long stem crossed low by a horizontal bar; same as E-a
4-like head, stem crossed low by a bar doubled or smudged at the base; same as E-a
Isolated tall stem with flag-like angled head, no crossbar; matches E-n angled head and stem
Minim/u pair followed by a short stem crossed by a bar (u+); exact match to E-t
